decisions: [lineage: B] Type family: Archivo (Google Fonts, OFL) for all text and numerals, loaded via next/font/google with axes ['wdth']; width axis is the system (wide 112% = who, normal 100% = reading, narrow 75% = numerals >= text-2xl). Extremes from B (wdth 125/800, wdth 62) clamped to 112/75 by critic. Verified in font file: tnum, pnum, lnum, zero, case present; glyphs → − × ≈ present.
[lineage: B+C family, A usage rule] Mono: Martian Mono 400 (OFL), preload false, used only for literal code and filenames; never for labels, tags, deltas or n/method.

[lineage: critic] Newsreader serif (C) cut: slower to skim for recruiters and the editorial-serif cliché C flagged itself. Switzer (A) cut: Fontshare self-hosting and unverified tnum, while Archivo has tnum and ships via next/font/google.
[lineage: critic] ↗ glyph is missing from both fonts; external-link marker is the Phosphor ArrowUpRight icon (@phosphor-icons/react, frontend installs) with sr-only '(opens in a new tab)'.
[lineage: A] Type scale: major third 1.25 on a 17px base, fluid rem clamps 390 -> 1440; one off-scale 15px step for captions. Display 48 -> 92px (home name), CTA 42 -> 128px (footer).
[lineage: critic] No italic loaded or used; no uppercase/tracked labels; no eyebrows (A/B/C consensus on the latter).

[lineage: A/B/C consensus] Palette: cool blue-grey paper oklch(0.975 0.004 247) + blue-black ink oklch(0.21 0.02 262), muted, border, rule; dark scheme via prefers-color-scheme, no toggle; light is canonical.

[lineage: B+C colour, C usage, A meaning] Single accent = highlighter mark yellow oklch(0.91 0.16 100) light / oklch(0.87 0.16 100) dark, used only as a fill behind ink text: one resting mark per page on the headline measured result, plus hover/focus/:target citation sweeps and ::selection. Never text, button fill, border or background.
[lineage: critic] A's cobalt accent cut (SaaS-blue risk); B's yellow plates and full-bleed yellow footer cut (warning-sign read, dilutes the mark).

[lineage: critic, computed] Contrast verified by OKLab -> sRGB script: fg/bg 16.50 (dark 16.12), muted/bg 6.92 (8.38), marked text 13.67 (12.68), danger/bg 6.16 (7.02), input border 3.99/3.65 (4.01/3.68). All ratios listed in DESIGN.md.

[lineage: A+B+C convergent] Primary signature hook 'the retract': solid after-bar contracts from before length to true ratio (Edge Node 18.17%) in 720ms on cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); SSR renders settled, JS only arms off-screen rows; numbers never move.
[lineage: critic] The retract ends with the highlighter mark sweeping behind the after value (240ms, starting at 640ms), tying primary and secondary into one 'this number is sourced' grammar.
[lineage: C] Secondary hook 'checked against source': citation markers [n], Tufte sidenotes, end Sources list, CSS :has() twin highlight scoped to .case/.ledger, no JS.

[lineage: critic] Cut B's 'to scale' numerals (double-encodes the retract ratio, works on 2/6 rows, 176px numeral enters the LCP race) and B's Probe cursor island (third interaction, JS cost; DESIGN.base allows one signature).
[lineage: C] Booktabs tables (1.5px top, 0.75px under header, 1.5px bottom; no row borders) for every ledger, timeline and data table.
[lineage: C pattern, A outline] Before/after bars differ by pattern not colour: before = 45° muted hatch with 1px border outline, after = solid fg; no background track.
[lineage: B] Shape: 2px radius on every control, 0 on tables/figures/images; no shadows, no cards, no gradients (hatch is the only repeating-linear-gradient, as a data encoding).
[lineage: A/B] Grid 12/8/4 columns, gutters 24/20/16, margin clamp(20px, 4.44vw, 64px), 1312px max content; nav 64px; hero top padding 64/32px.
[lineage: B/C] Section gap 128px desktop / 80px mobile (A's 160 cut as too long).

[lineage: A] Hero: asymmetric split, cols 1-7 static H1 (LCP) + descriptor span + G1 subline + 'Contact Arnav' + 'See the measured work'; cols 9-12 one-row ledger specimen bottom-aligned to the CTA row. Wireframe's H1 line stagger declined.

[lineage: C] Case study: three zones at >=1280 (front-matter rail cols 1-3 sticky, text cols 4-9, sidenotes cols 10-12); collapses to rail-above + inline notes at 768, summary block + Sources list at 390.
[lineage: A/B/C consensus] Work index preview docks in cols 9-12 and slides on translateY to the hovered/focused row; no cursor-follow; touch uses inline disclosure.
[lineage: B] Home 'More work' teaser: inline underlined links, not chips.
[lineage: C] /work more-work as an appendix-style definition list (no card chrome); /about timeline in booktabs grammar and skills as a back-of-book index.

[lineage: critic, resolving flagged conflict] Scroll reveals: none anywhere; the only viewport-triggered motion is the retract. Overrides the wireframe's optional motion-scroll-reveal-restrained; components/motion/Reveal.tsx is not to be used on content.

[lineage: critic, resolving flagged conflict] Contact intent has one label, 'Contact Arnav', in nav, hero and footer big CTA on every page (supersedes 'Let's talk' and the case-aware CTA); /contact footer uses 'See the work'.
[lineage: A/B/C consensus] Ledger caption: 'Measured results. Each one links to its source.' (em dash removed).

[lineage: A, extended by critic] Edge Node precision: full source precision 5.356 s -> 0.973 s everywhere (UI, prose, FAQ, meta, OG, llms.txt); derived values computed at build time and rounded (-82%, 5.5×). Supersedes rounded 5.36/0.97 in SEO_STRATEGY and WIREFRAMES.

[lineage: A/B/C consensus] Motion: transform/opacity only; house curve cubic-bezier(0.2,0,0,1); durations 120/180/240/300/720ms; no bounce, loops, count-ups, parallax, marquee, custom cursor or smooth-scroll hijack; every animation has a reduced-motion static fallback.
